svg.desc: Arrows mean increasing specificity. FR and NFR are parallel behavior and quality concerns, not sequential steps. This teaching illustration still requires more specific quality conditions.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 1 | Turn a lunch idea into verifiable requirements
User Story | Why do I need it?
Office workers want a suitable meal during their lunch break so that
they can return to work on time.
FR | What should it do?
Provide ordering, customization
, payment and order lookup.
NFR | How well should it work?
The process should be
understandable, responses
dependable and operation
convenient.
Constraints | What restrictions apply?
Respect confirmed ingredient restrictions, budget and equipment
conditions.
Acceptance Criteria | How can we confirm it works?
In specified scenarios, customers can order correctly, handle
allergy restrictions, pay and look up orders; quality measures are
also tested.
Arrows mean increasing specificity. FR and NFR are parallel behavior
and quality concerns, not sequential steps. This teaching illustration
still requires more specific quality conditions.
